# Table 7: RQ3 calibration

Held-out folds only (04 §5.4); alpha 0.1 (each experiment's calibration.alpha, Alpha column). Coverage, set size, risk-coverage AURC (verified score V vs fused score F; H3c: AURC V − F below 0 favours V) and NO_FAULT rates are bench_summary 1.2 entries (03 §13.3), pooled over seeds; lower AURC is better. AC@1 and Retrieval@K carry summary.json's 95% cluster-bootstrap interval; coverage, the AURCs, AURC V − F and the false-alarm and wrong NO_FAULT rates carry the 95% cluster-bootstrap interval of rq3-intervals/<id>/summary.json where one is committed (scripts/rq3_intervals.py, #555; 04 §8). Set-size columns are over the runs with a set; Runs not ok counts all the group's rows (fault cases and normal windows). τ_nf follows the 04 §12 row of 2026-11-21 (logged 26 Nov; ADR 20261121-ak-calibration-fit-conventions): when its rank index lands on +∞, τ_nf = default_tau with calibrated = false, which gives a held-out false-alarm rate of 1; Table 7c is the literal 04 §5.4 reading that row reports as a sensitivity analysis. Pooled rows (system as stratum) are secondary (04 §10 rule 3). Protocol: see Sources.
